headlines.description: Substitute Jacob Ramsey struck late on as Newcastle came from 2-0 down to snatch a 2-2 draw against Bournemouth and preserve Matthias Jaissle's unbeaten start to his time on Tyneside.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jacob Ramsey scores last-gasp equaliser to salvage a point for Newcastle, Bournemouth drop points from winning position again

keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Newcastle United 0, Bournemouth 1. Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) left footed shot from very close range to the top left corner.
Anthony Elanga (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury António Silva (Bournemouth).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Own Goal by Malick Thiaw, Newcastle United. Newcastle United 0, Bournemouth 2.
Goal! Newcastle United 1, Bournemouth 2. Harvey Barnes (Newcastle United) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Lewis Hall.
Delay in match because of an injury Evanilson (Bournemouth).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Yoane Wissa (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Matias Fernandez-Pardo replaces Joe Willock.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Jacob Ramsey replaces Lewis Miley.
Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Lewis Cook replaces Tyler Adams.
Substitution, Bournemouth. David Brooks replaces Justin Kluivert.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Sean Steur replaces Nico González.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Jacob Murphy replaces Anthony Elanga.
Delay in match because of an injury Adam Smith (Bournemouth).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Newcastle United 2, Bournemouth 2. Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Daniel Jebbison replaces Marcus Tavernier.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Ben Gannon-Doak replaces Rayan.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Tino Livramento replaces Lewis Hall.
Adam Smith (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Ryan Christie replaces Alex Scott.
Second Half ends, Newcastle United 2, Bournemouth 2.
